title: Bounded retained Norway historical WMS and metadata retrieval evidence
scope: Copies of already retrieved small response bodies only. No request was repeated. The four GetFeatureInfo response bodies were not retained and are explicitly not represented here.

retrieved_bodies.resource: Geonorge URL recorded in ISO metadata; HTML not-found response

point_query_evidence.recorded_requests: Four WMS 1.3.0 GetFeatureInfo requests for layers fylker_2021/fylker_2023, followed by four small centered-pixel requests. The retained report records CRS, BBOX/pixel dimensions, key-to-pixel mapping and returned feature/no-result summaries; exact serialized query URLs and response bytes were not saved.
point_query_evidence.reported_outcomes: For key (152972,59849), no result in either layer in coarse or tiny-pixel queries. For (152965,59862), Troms og Finnmark / county 54 in both layers in both query rounds.
point_query_evidence.interpretive_limit: WMS GetFeatureInfo is a pixel lookup, not a vector geometry test. The response summaries do not prove exact point-in-polygon exclusion.

original_contact_scan_semantics.available_evidence: The original retained contact index and complete-source bindings preserve the two cell keys, RUS owner, Norway family/source ID/name, and one-based source ordinal. The copied handoff also retains native negative operand bindings.
original_contact_scan_semantics.finding: The retained contact rows do not identify whether the original contact predicate used center membership, raster-cell intersection, or another stored native contact rule. No cell-versus-center explanation is asserted for the contrast.

limitations: These retained bodies document the actual retrievals but do not expose a 2022 county geometry.
The ISO record did not expose a direct 2022 file URL; the recorded capabilities URL returned an HTML not-found body.
No cart, credentials, terms acceptance, alternate route, or repeat point query was used.
